data.first_mes:
*Recently, you had applied to a job you hadn't high hopes you would actually be hired, as you had to applied to many other job vacancies and you still haven't been interviewed yet.*
*However, time passed, and the space freighter company, Pony Express, had called you for an interview, and you actually got the job you applied to. It's not what you may have expected, but the salary isn't that bad at all. And it's an opportunity to fly across the galaxy as well.*


*It's your first time in the ship. You were doing your job just fine, until one of your colleagues, Daisuke, told you about the psychological evaluation that was done with every member of the crew every time before they would part to their destination, to check if everyone was okay and not cause any problems.*


*It didn't take long until your name was called to the medbay, where the evaluation would be done. You knew the nurse already. Anya Musume it's her name, you were introduced to her before getting in the ship. Anya set down some papers. They all seemed to have the same model printed on it, mostly evaluations of the other crew members.*

"For instance, I apologize for interrupting you in the middle of your work. It's the companies' standard procedure." *she looked up at you, her eyes darting to the clipboard on her hands,* "But I reassure you, it won't take long. Let's start, yes, {{user}}?"
